zh-CN.Totals and nominal dimensions are useful: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.Review Cost at the Purchase Boundary: Review Cost at the Purchase Boundary
zh-CN.Judge material by full sheets and purcha: Judge material by full sheets and purchasable stock, not theoretical part area. Include delivery, substitutions, specialty thicknesses, damaged-sheet risk, reusable offcuts, and the point where a small dimension change triggers another sheet. For installed work, add the labor and schedule impact of field fitting or replacement. The cheapest-looking input is not cheaper if it creates another trip or rebuild.
zh-CN.Translate the approved plan into referen: Translate the approved plan into reference faces, first cuts, setup groups, part IDs, inspection points, and safe support. Approve one sample before repeating an operation, especially when hardware clearance, paired parts, or a locked stop controls the result. Labels should preserve project, cabinet, material, orientation, and revision through machining, assembly, delivery, and installation.
zh-CN.CutList is the closest WoodCutTool actio: CutList is the closest WoodCutTool action page for this problem. Use it to convert the verified dimensions, quantities, and constraints into a saved plan or project-specific starting point. Keep its output connected to the same material codes and part IDs used in purchasing and the shop. A tool can expose geometry and totals; it cannot make an incomplete input list correct.
zh-CN.Close the Loop After the Build: Close the Loop After the Build
zh-CN.Record actual material purchased, substi: Record actual material purchased, substitutions, damaged or replacement parts, useful offcuts, setup changes, field-fit dimensions, and the installed result. Compare those facts with the approved plan and note why they differed. This project-specific evidence improves the next cut list, quote, material policy, and template far more than an undocumented success or a waste percentage by itself.
zh-CN.Create material codes for thickness, spe: 围绕“How to Group Cut List Parts by Material”的实用流程，帮助个人木工和小型工坊在购买板材前看清零件、排版、余料和切割顺序。
zh-CN.For “how to group cut list parts by mate: 先把项目尺寸、零件数量、材料类型和可见面要求写清楚。CutList 只有拿到真实约束，才能生成可以落地的板材排版。
zh-CN.Capture nominal and actual thickness, sp: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.A reviewable sequence is to Build a shor: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.The highest-value check prevents this fa: The highest-value check prevents this failure: A vague material name such as plywood can silently mix case stock, backs, drawer bottoms, finished ends, and templates in one impossible layout. Put that check immediately before the irreversible step. If the current evidence cannot resolve the question, pause the affected operation, preserve the material and revision state, and obtain a measurement, product specification, test piece, or approval rather than improvising.
zh-CN.Material Grouping Guide provides the sup: Material Grouping Guide provides the supporting method, benchmark, or detailed planning context for this decision. Read it before approving an assumption that changes sheet count, visible grain, hardware fit, structural capacity, installation clearance, or project cost. Save the relevant conclusion with the final revision so the next estimator or builder can understand why the rule was chosen.
zh-CN.Answer the controlling question: Every p: 确认所有零件名称和数量。
zh-CN.Verify and classify the inputs: nominal: 设置真实板材尺寸与锯缝。
zh-CN.Follow the reviewable workflow: Build a: 检查纹理方向和可见面。
zh-CN.Stop before this failure: A vague materi: 保存或导出最终切割方案。
zh-CN.Save the final CutList output with the s: Save the final CutList output with the supporting Material Grouping Guide decision.
